name: event_detector_portfolio_fresh_aware_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: EVENT_DETECTOR_PORTFOLIO_FRESH_AWARE_20261108 — PORTFOLIO_FRESH_NEEDED must compare and sort aware UTC timestamps. A naive datetime.min sentinel raised TypeError against aware timestamptz values on every run, and the per-detector except only logged it, so the lane exited 0 with one of its ten detectors dead (LQ-20261107-691).
